name: mem-zero
description: Self-hosted memory server for AI coding assistants. Store, search, and manage persistent context across sessions so your tools remember what happened last week without stuffing everything into the context window. Each project gets its own isolated vector collection with automatic fact extraction, deduplication, and semantic search. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and any MCP-compatible client. Includes a bundled LLM for zero-config operation, or connect to Ollama or OpenAI for better quality. Web dashboard included for browsing and managing memories.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Web dashboard and MCP server HTTP port

variables.name: LLM Backend
variables.description: Leave blank to auto-detect: openai if OpenAI API Key is set, else ollama if Ollama URL is set, else bundled. Set explicitly only to override. NOTE: an explicit 'bundled' ignores your Ollama/OpenAI settings.

variables.name: Ollama URL
variables.description: Ollama API base URL (only used when backend=ollama)

variables.name: LLM Model
variables.description: Ollama language model (only used when backend=ollama)

variables.name: Embedder Model
variables.description: Ollama embedding model (only used when backend=ollama)

variables.name: Embedder Dimensions
variables.description: Optional. Leave blank for the per-backend default (768 for Ollama/bundled, the model's native size for OpenAI). Set only to override.

variables.name: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: API key for OpenAI-compatible backend (only used when backend=openai)

variables.name: OpenAI Base URL
variables.description: Base URL for any OpenAI-compatible API serving BOTH /chat/completions and /embeddings (OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, LM Studio, vLLM, LiteLLM)

variables.name: Bundled Threads
variables.description: CPU threads for bundled LLM inference

variables.name: API Key
variables.description: API key for MCP and REST endpoints (leave empty to disable). Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: Dashboard Username
variables.description: Username for web dashboard login (leave empty to disable auth)

variables.name: Dashboard Password
variables.description: Password for web dashboard login (leave empty to disable auth)

variables.name: Diagnostics
variables.description: Enable performance and accuracy metrics on the dashboard

variables.name: Rerank Enabled
variables.description: Re-score search results with a local cross-encoder for sharper relevance separation (CPU; downloads a small model on first use)

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the Qdrant and mem-zero processes run as. Files in the Storage path are chowned to this id once on first start (99 = nobody, the Unraid default). Set 0 to run as root like older releases.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for the service processes (100 = users, the Unraid default).

variables.name: Rerank Model
variables.description: Cross-encoder model used when Rerank Enabled is true
